domains.label: External Barriers
domains.tagline: They know how, but something outside blocks them

sub_drivers.label: Homesickness and grief
sub_drivers.description: Missing family and food, mourning a former role ("I was somebody back home")

sub_drivers.label: Loneliness
sub_drivers.description: Eating alone, having no one to call when something goes wrong

sub_drivers.label: Shame and embarrassment
sub_drivers.description: Mortified after a mistake in class, hiding that they are struggling

sub_drivers.label: Guilt
sub_drivers.description: Feeling they are wasting what the family sacrificed, enjoying life while family struggles back home

sub_drivers.label: Self-doubt
sub_drivers.description: "Everyone else belongs here but me," wondering if they were admitted by mistake

sub_drivers.label: Fear and anxiety
sub_drivers.description: Dread of failing a class, losing visa status, or having no job after graduation

sub_drivers.label: Frustration and resentment
sub_drivers.description: Anger at confusing systems, at being treated as an outsider

sub_drivers.label: Exhaustion and burnout
sub_drivers.description: Constantly translating and adapting, running on little sleep

sub_drivers.label: Academic norms

sub_drivers.label: Career norms
sub_drivers.description: How to write a U.S. resume, interview, network

sub_drivers.label: Daily-life systems
sub_drivers.description: How to open a bank account, find housing, use insurance, get around

sub_drivers.label: Visa and work rules
sub_drivers.description: What is and is not allowed, how to keep status

sub_drivers.label: Money management

sub_drivers.label: Self-advocacy

sub_drivers.label: Visa and work restrictions

classification_rules: Which domain: a feeling goes in Emotional Burden. "I don't know how" goes in Skill & Knowledge Gaps. "I know how, but I can't, or it isn't there" goes in External Barriers.

Buckets: it is fine for a student to have nothing in some of the three domains. Themes can sit in only one domain (for example only Emotional Burden, or only External Barriers) or in any combination (for example Emotional Burden and Skill & Knowledge Gaps). Never add a theme just to fill a domain.
Emotion vs. cause: Emotional Burden names only the feeling. The cause comes from the other two domains.
Visa test case: the fear is Fear and anxiety, not understanding the rules is a Skill & Knowledge Gap, and the restrictions are Visa and work restrictions.
Employer vs. system: an employer refusing to sponsor is Job market access. The visa rule itself is Visa and work restrictions.
Professional vs. personal: career contacts are Professional network. Friends, family and local support are Social support.
Privacy: the tool tags visa fear as a theme and never records an actual immigration status.
